about.en: AAPU is the Direxion Daily AAPL Bull 2X Shares ETF, a leveraged single-stock exchange-traded fund sponsored by Direxion that seeks 200% of the daily performance of the common shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on Nasdaq and is not an investment in AAPL shares themselves.
